venue.name: South Mansion
venue.address: SOUTH MANSION, 30 NGA TSIN WAI ROAD, KOWLOON CITY DISTRICT, KLN

warnings: Amended general building plan and occupation permit, 1983. Boundaries are interpreted at wall centre lines. Current occupation and alterations require field confirmation.

units.label: Entrance stair and landing
units.evidence: UP 20R and parallel treads. The separate upper-flight detail belongs to this stair.

units.label: Service riser C
units.evidence: Enclosed bay C. Leaders identify telephone and electrical risers as a pair; the assignment of each service to C or D is unclear.

units.label: Service riser D
units.evidence: Enclosed bay D beside C, immediately below the landing. Individual service assignment needs review.

units.label: Shop lavatory
units.evidence: LAV. and sanitary fixtures inside the compartment opening to the shop.

units.label: Ground-floor shop
units.evidence: SHOP, shutter lines and the permit for non-domestic shop use. Wall centre lines bound this area.
